reasoning.step1:
Plan: identify if document is invoice → extract fields exactly as present (no guessing) → handle VAT groups separately.

1) Classification
- Document contains clear invoice indicators: "Rechnung / Nr.: 4137876", "Rechnungsdatum 29.01.2024", line items, "Summe exkl. MwSt", VAT lines, and "Gesamtsumme EUR 827,41". No exclusion terms like "Mahnung" or "Zahlungserinnerung". Therefore treat as an invoice.

2) Locate Invoice.Date
- Found "Rechnungsdatum                                 29.01.2024".
- Extract Invoice.Date = "29.01.2024" (exact string as printed).

3) Locate GrandTotal.Amount
- Found "Gesamtsumme                  EUR                                827,41".
- Grand total numeric value = 827,41 → convert to numeric representation preserving two decimals: 827.41.

4) Determine Sender.VatId
- Two VAT numbers appear:
  - "Ihre UID/VAT-Nr.                            ATU22642807" (labelled "Ihre" = your/customer VAT).
  - Footer: "UID-Nr.:    ATU79411414" associated with Wurth EF GmbH (footer company).
- Rule: Sender.VatId = tax ID of the sender. The footer lists "Wurth EF GmbH" with "UID-Nr.: ATU79411414". Use that exact VAT: "ATU79411414".
- Do not infer beyond these explicit occurrences.

5) Extract VAT groups (rates, net amounts, VAT amounts)
- Document shows two VAT lines:
  - "10%      MWSt         für   562,90                                 56,29"
    -> VAT rate 10%, net amount 562,90, VAT amount 56,29.
  - "20%      MWSt         für   173,52                                 34,70"
    -> VAT rate 20%, net amount 173,52, VAT amount 34,70.
- Preserve decimals exactly as given.
- Convert rates to numbers without percent sign: 10 and 20.
- Convert amounts to numeric form keeping two decimals:
  - Net amounts: 562.90 and 173.52.
  - VAT amounts: 56.29 and 34.70.

6) Cross-check totals
- Sum of net amounts: 562.90 + 173.52 = 736.42 which matches "Summe exkl. MwSt 736,42".
- Sum of VAT amounts: 56.29 + 34.70 = 90.99.
- Net + VAT = 736.42 + 90.99 = 827.41 matches GrandTotal.

7) No inference applied to any missing field; all extracted values come from explicit text.
